Zachary, I'm sorry, nothing has moved since Tuesday. You've been waiting on this order since August 8, and that's too long.

Your NerdQaxe++ return still shows Awaiting Arrival, so our Chattanooga warehouse hasn't checked it in yet. The Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 is still out of stock and still has no ship date.

We still owe you an answer on the BC04 at the $10 you were quoted, so I've pushed it to the team again. They pick it up at 10am ET today and will reply by email, so you don't need to wait here.
